description: This file implements a fake SPI bus driver with emulation capabilities for testing, including functions for registering, initializing, and finding emulated SPI devices, as well as handling SPI data transfer and release operations.

methods.name: spi_emul_get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration value for the given SPI emulation device.

methods.name: spi_emul_find
methods.description: Finds an emulated SPI device based on chip select value.

methods.name: spi_emul_io
methods.description: Handles data transfer for the emulated SPI device.

methods.name: spi_emul_release
methods.description: Stub function for releasing SPI device, no operation.

methods.name: spi_emul_init
methods.description: Initializes a new SPI emulation device and its list.

methods.name: spi_emul_register
methods.description: Registers a new SPI emulator device.
